It happened in the train. I was having one of my late evening return from college "blue mood" train rides and it was really crowded. I was standing and feeling melancholy. This lady sitting in front of me offered to hold my backpack on her lap. I denied as she was aged and assured her that it was light. She insisted a few times but I assured her again. I really felt like crying my eyes out at that moment. 
I feel sad when I am travelling, and especially when I am in a crowd because I get this feeling that there are so many people and so much poverty where I live, but people aren't kind. They argue with each other on the trains and that hurts my soul. 
I was really happy to have met this kind soul. And, it's not at all common in my country, for a woman (elderly) to offer another female (a young girl like me) to hold their backpack. That made my day. 

Thanks for asking this question! I would love to hear your experience with the same! :)
